assertions: Invalid account details are rejected synchronously with stable product codes before any repository mutation.
Valid display name, neighborhood, country prefix and local phone are compatibility-normalized once in the shared runtime.
Repeated Save while a mutation is active is suppressed before another coroutine or repository call is created.
A database uniqueness failure from the profile patch is mapped to a stable localized collision result without masking later recovery, SOS or unrelated failures.
The original release proved that global local-number indexes rejected duplicates, but independent review found that this contradicted country-aware Auth resolution.
Forward migration 20261010101500 replaces these indexes and the authoritative evidence is account-details-validation-collisions-512b5bf5.json.
limits: No complete native UI matrix was repeated solely for this Product SHA; Android, Web/Wasm and iOS compiled the changed shared runtime and the focused Wasm browser suite executed it.
The probe does not emit or retain profile identifiers, phone values, emails, credentials, connection strings, backup keys or private host paths.
This unit does not promote ACCOUNT-RECOVERY-SECRET, ACCOUNT-PASSWORD-LEGACY, avatar, SOS, logout, account deletion or any other Account/Profile subflow.
